statusHistory.note: Operator-commissioned (West Hollywood/LA hip-spots war room, 2026-11-04), fourth pin in the cluster (Los Feliz, second after Skylight Books). Verified open via live Google Maps listing (4.4/200 reviews, open until 6pm, busier than usual at time of check) and claude-in-chrome for exact coordinates. Research floor: Kettl's own official site (our-story page -- primary-source company history), The Infatuation, World Tea News (trade press, independently confirms founder Zach Mangan's book and the company's Japan-incorporated structure), Discover Los Angeles, matchaplaces.com, joe.coffee listing -- six preferred-source-type consults, exceeding the five-source floor. Reddit leg: not separately searched this piece given time; logged as unattempted rather than claimed met. Google reviews leg: read live via claude-in-chrome; recent reviews consistently praise unsweetened, authentically-served matcha (Hukuju, Suiteki/Nishio cultivars named specifically) and a guided 'Teas of Japan' tasting experience staffed personally, with no notable recent negative pattern found. Real texture used: founded 2010, the only US-based Japanese tea company fully incorporated in Japan (Fukuoka office), run by Zach and Minami Mangan; this Los Feliz cafe is the company's LA flagship, opened Spring 2024, with a four-seat tasting counter. Hero image is a real operator-sourced photo but under the Discover pixel spec (348x348) -- used anyway per licenseNote, same compromise as the two prior pins in this cluster. Full six-locale coverage done inline, single coordinator, no subagents. Headline leads with a concrete USP (specialist Japanese-tea depth / tasting counter, not a generic matcha cafe) and avoids the 'The X that Y' construction per operator instruction.
